sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Lesson 8.3 of Dataset Fundamentals: Codebooks, Data Provenance, and Release Notes. When datasets transition from exploratory notebooks into clinical trials or production pipelines, informal spreadsheets become dangerous engineering liabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Today we unify four pillars from Michener, Moreau, Preston-Werner, and Baggerly: W3C PROV-O Lineage Algebras, Nilpotent Transitive Reachability, Sentinel-Aware Codebook Fidelity Scoring, and SemVer 2.0 Dominance Lattices linked by SHA-256 parent commit hashes.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us trace how raw encodings become auditable ML releases across three tightly coupled architectural stages.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: First, in Ingestion and Raw Encodings, telemetry containing integers like 1, 2, and 99 passes through the Codebook Translation Table, mapping 1 to Active, 2 to Control, and 99 to Missing. Second, the W3C PROV-O Provenance Graph links Raw Ingestion through a Codebook Normalization Activity attributed to the Data Engineering Pipeline Agent, yielding a Cleaned Dataset Entity. Finally, that validated artifact receives a SemVer 2.0 identifier like v2.1.0 and a SHA-256 Release Manifest.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: To replace ad-hoc spreadsheets with mathematical accountability, Definition 8.3.1 models dataset lineage as a Directed Acyclic Graph G equals V comma E conforming to the W3C PROV-O specification by Moreau and Missier.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: The vertex set V partitions cleanly into three disjoint classes: Entities E representing immutable data tables or checkpoints; Activities A representing ETL jobs or SGD training steps; and Agents Ag representing responsible CI runners or principal investigators. Directed edges E encode four asymmetric causal dependencies: Generation wasGeneratedBy, Usage used, Derivation wasDerivedFrom, and Attribution or Association via wasAttributedTo and wasAssociatedWith.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: How do we audit all upstream sources of a model checkpoint algorithmically across a 12-stage pipeline? Definition 8.3.2 topologically orders nodes v1 through vn into a forward adjacency matrix A.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Matrix power A to the m counts all distinct m-hop causal paths, yielding the Transitive Reachability Matrix R. Crucially, Theorem 8.3.1 proves Nilpotent Finite Convergence: because any valid PROV-O DAG is acyclic with maximum depth L strictly less than n, every power beyond L vanishes identically to zero. Therefore I minus A is always invertible, terminating in L steps—as shown in our 5-node chain where severing e1 to a1 collapses row 1 and proves model e3 lost traceability!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Beyond reachability masks, how do architects quantify structural maintainability and cascade risk across evolving workflows? Definition 8.3.4 adapts McCabe's topological metric to define Lineage Cyclomatic Complexity: M_lineage equals edge count E minus vertex count V plus twice the number of weakly connected components P.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In our 6-node production benchmark—five connected ML pipeline vertices plus one isolated legacy CSV dump, so 4 edges, 6 vertices, and P equals 2 components—complexity equals 4 minus 6 plus 4, yielding M equal to 2. However, when a manual Excel edit severs edge e1 to a1 in the Duke failure mode, edges drop to 3 and components fragment to P equals 3, raising M to 3 while severing lineage. Conversely, overly tangled pipelines exceeding M equals 15 amplify silent data cascades as Sambasivan warned in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us explore Interactive Laboratory 1 below me: the W3C PROV-O Lineage DAG and Transitive Reachability Matrix Studio, matching Simulator 8.3 Tab A.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In the Production ML Pipeline scenario, selecting Model Checkpoint e3 highlights all 5 reachable nodes along the chain while keeping orphan Legacy Dump e4 isolated at M equals 2, P equals 2. Now switch to the Duke Chemosensitivity Scandal scenario or inspect e1 and e4 to watch the edge e1 to a1 fracture and turn the reachability matrix entries red!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Time for Active Checkpoint 1! Suppose a production checkpoint e_model traces through a 12-stage DAG with depth L, and we compare healthy execution against the Duke scenario where manual edits sever e1 to a1.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Why does Theorem 8.3.1 guarantee finite reachability termination without infinite loops, and how does severing e1 to a1 manifest inside matrices R and complexity M_lineage? Choose Option A, B, or C below.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Now let us formalize semantic decoding. In Definition 8.3.3, let attribute X have N observations and codebook dictionary M map raw tokens into verified labels S, explicitly separating domain codes from reserved missingness sentinels like 77 meaning Refused or 99 meaning Don't Know.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: The Codebook Fidelity Score F_codebook equals the fraction of entries present in Dom of M whose mapped label is not UNKNOWN. Take batch 1, 2, 1, 99, 2, 42 under codebook 1 Positive, 2 Negative, and 99 Missing_Refused. Crucially, 99 counts as valid because its non-response meaning is documented, whereas 42 fails as UNKNOWN—giving 5 sixths or 83.33 percent, which stays blocked below a 95 percent CI gate! And remember: never replace 99 with zero or mean imputation, because refusal is Missing Not At Random and carries behavioral signal.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: When publishing dataset release D t plus 1 relative to baseline D t, version increments are not ad-hoc marketing guesses. Definition 8.3.5 establishes a strict total dominance lattice: MAJOR dominates MINOR, which dominates PATCH.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Any breaking schema modification—such as dropping or renaming columns—forces a MAJOR bump like v1.2.3 to v2.0.0, even if Minor extensions and Patch typo fixes occur simultaneously. Otherwise, additive schema extensions or volume shifts above threshold tau trigger MINOR v1.3.0, while pure codebook label repairs trigger PATCH v1.2.4. Finally, each manifest chains cryptographically via SHA-256 over Manifest t, SemVer t, and predecessor hash H t minus 1 so any historical mutation shatters downstream signatures!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Laboratory 2 below me: the Codebook Fidelity and SemVer 2.0 Dominance Studio, matching Simulator 8.3 Tab B.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Notice the baseline uncurated batch scores 83.33 percent, 5 of 6 valid, because sentinel 99 is documented while 42 is unmapped—so the automated CI Gate reads BLOCKED below 95 percent! Remediate it to 100 percent APPROVED, and test checking Breaking Schema Change alongside Minor and Patch flags below me to watch v1.2.3 jump directly to v2.0.0 and rotate the SHA-256 commit hash!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 2 evaluates your command of Codebook Fidelity scoring, missingness sentinels, and SemVer 2.0 dominance.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Given raw survey batch 1, 2, 1, 99, 2, 42 under documented code 99 Missing_Refused, compute exact Fidelity Score, explain why replacing 99 with zero or mean violates NHANES survey discipline, and determine the version output when Breaking, Minor, and Patch changes occur simultaneously from v1.2.3. Choose Option A, B, or C below.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us examine two defining real-world studies showing why formalized codebooks and unbroken provenance decide clinical safety.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: First, the US CDC NHANES survey examines over 5,000 participants yearly. Variable RIDAGEYR top-coded ages 80 and above strictly as 80 for anonymity, while codes 7 or 77 mean Refused, 9 or 99 mean Don't Know, and dot means Skip-Pattern Inapplicable. Treating 80 or 99 as naive floats ruins cardiovascular models—prevented only via SAS codebooks paired with XML dictionaries. Second, in the 2006 to 2010 Duke Oncology scandal, undocumented manual Excel edits introduced off-by-one column shifts and flipped drug labels—costing Baggerly and Coombes over 1,500 forensic hours and forcing three clinical trial suspensions and over two dozen paper retractions.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 3 brings together Self-Assessments 1 and 2 across autonomous driving provenance and cryptographic release chains.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In a self-driving pipeline where atmospheric rain noise is stripped from lidar_raw.bag by C++ binary voxel_filter running on airflow-worker-prod-04, classify the three W3C PROV-O primitives and explain how SHA-256 parent chaining exposes retroactive edits to historical partition D0. Select Option A, B, or C below.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: How do organizations integrate codebooks, W3C PROV-O graphs, and hash-chained SemVer into daily ML delivery without slowing engineers down?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Modern DataOps platforms unify four automated controls inside Continuous Data Integration gates: versioned machine-readable codebooks requiring fidelity above 95 percent or 100 percent in clinical pipelines; DVC content-addressable lineage locks verified by reachability matrices; Open Provenance W3C JSON-LD exports tied to Airflow or CI worker Identities; and immutable Markdown plus SHA-256 release manifests preventing silent data cascades.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us inspect our verified Python implementation, ProvenanceAndReleaseManager, built with Pydantic V2 models, NumPy matrix powers, and Python hashlib.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Method compute_reachability initializes the identity matrix and multiplies adjacency powers until nilpotent convergence. Executing our benchmark verifies 83.33 percent codebook fidelity on 1, 2, 1, 99, 2, 42; 6 vertices, 4 edges, cyclomatic complexity M equal to 2, model depends on raw True, and unrelated reachable False; plus all SemVer assertions jumping from 1.2.3 to 2.0.0 under dominance alongside a 64-character SHA-256 commit digest.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: To conclude Lesson 8.3, let us crystallize our Four Cardinal Rules of Codebooks, Data Provenance, and Release Notes.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Rule 1: Document every censoring rule and MNAR sentinel code like 77 or 99 inside versioned codebooks, enforcing F_codebook above 95 percent in CI gates. Rule 2: Track all transformations as W3C PROV-O Entities, Activities, and Agents, banning untracked manual spreadsheets. Rule 3: Verify transitive reachability R via nilpotent powers and monitor cyclomatic complexity M_lineage against fragmentation or dense coupling. Rule 4: Publish deterministic SemVer 2.0 releases anchored by SHA-256 parent commit chains H_t. Onward to Lesson 8.4: Creating Effective Documentation!
